finding: Lambda function timeout due to increased batch size causing processing exceeding 15-minute limit, leading to downstream task failure and stale Snowpipe data.

steps.action: Increase Lambda function timeout from 15 minutes to 30 minutes
Reduce batch size back to previous safe level (e.g., 5000 records)
Redeploy the Lambda function with updated configuration
Monitor next batch processing time to ensure completion within timeout
Manually trigger downstream Snowflake load DAG to catch up
Verify Snowpipe resumes ingesting new files
